name: Hanabi Trio
summary: A cooperative card game. Each player sees everyone's cards but their own and plays coloured cards 1 to 5 in order onto three piles, using hints, discards and plays; the team wins together if it scores 13 or more of the 15 possible points.

player.meaning: IDs (#k) of the cards this seat holds, in order; seen by everyone (R6)
Faces (e.g. R1) of the held cards, index-paired with hand_ids; every seat except the owner sees them (R6)
Options offered this turn; filled only for the active seat, empty for all others (R9)
This seat's score; set to team_score at the end of every turn (R16)

game.meaning: IDs of the cards still in the deck, front = top; index-paired with deck_faces
Faces of the cards still in the deck, shuffled once at setup, front = top; hidden from every player (R2)
Always the number of entries in deck_ids
Fuses left; the game ends when this reaches 0
Revealed discarded or failed cards as '#id=face', in order
One public line per turn: hints with matched IDs, plays and discards with faces
-1 until the deck empties; then counts down the remaining turns

setup: Build the 30 faces: for each of R, G, B, three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s and one 5. Shuffle them once into deck_faces.
Set deck_ids to #1, #2, ..., #30 in order, so deck_ids[k] and deck_faces[k] are the same card.
Hand size is 5 with 2 players and 4 with 3 or 4 players.

Seat 1 takes the front hand-size entries of deck_ids and deck_faces together, in order, into hand_ids and hand_faces. Then seat 2 takes the next hand-size entries, and so on to the last seat. With 3 players, seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and the deck holds #13-#30.
Set deck_count to the length of deck_ids: 20 with 2 players, 18 with 3, 14 with 4.

Set pile_red, pile_green, pile_blue = 0, hint_tokens = 8, fuses = 3, team_score = 0, discard_pile = [], action_log = [], turns_played = 0, final_turns_left = -1, active_seat = 1, and every seat's total = 0.
Sync: each seat receives every seat's hand_ids, every other seat's hand_faces (never its own) and all public table attributes.

round.effect: Set legal_options of the active seat to: 'PLAY #id' for each id in its hand_ids; 'DISCARD #id' for each id in its hand_ids; and, if hint_tokens >= 1, 'HINT s v' for each other seat s and each v in {R,G,B,1,2,3,4,5} where at least one face in seat s's hand_faces has colour letter v or rank v. Set every other seat's legal_options to [].

Each seat receives its permitted view: all hand_ids, other seats' hand_faces, the piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, discard_pile, action_log, team_score, turns_played, active_seat, and its own legal_options.

round.answer: exactly one option from the active seat's legal_options
round.effect: Store the chosen option as this turn's choice.

When the choice is 'HINT s v': hint_tokens -= 1. Append to action_log 'turn {turns_played+1}: seat {active_seat} hints seat s v = ' followed by every id in seat s's hand_ids whose paired face matches v. No card moves.

When the choice is 'PLAY #id': find index i of #id in the active seat's hand_ids, take face = hand_faces[i], and remove index i from both hand_ids and hand_faces. If face rank == (pile of face colour) + 1: set that pile to the rank, team_score += 1, if rank == 5 and hint_tokens < 8 then hint_tokens += 1, and append 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, success' to action_log. Otherwise: fuses -= 1, append '#id=face' to discard_pile, and append 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, failure' to action_log.

When the choice is 'DISCARD #id': find index i of #id in the active seat's hand_ids, take face = hand_faces[i], and remove index i from both lists. Append '#id=face' to discard_pile, set hint_tokens = min(8, hint_tokens + 1), and append 'turn t: seat a discards #id = face' to action_log.

When the choice was PLAY or DISCARD and deck_ids is not empty: remove the front entry of deck_ids and of deck_faces together and append them to the end of the active seat's hand_ids and hand_faces. Set deck_count = length of deck_ids. If deck_count is now 0 and final_turns_left == -1, set final_turns_left = num_players + 1. After a HINT nobody draws.
Set every seat's total = team_score. turns_played += 1. If final_turns_left > 0, final_turns_left -= 1. active_seat = active_seat + 1, or 1 after the last seat.
Announce the last action_log line with the current pile_red, pile_green, pile_blue, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count and team_score.
End the game if fuses == 0 or team_score == 15 or final_turns_left == 0 or turns_played == 40; otherwise continue with the next round.

ending.condition: fuses == 0 OR team_score == 15 OR final_turns_left == 0 OR turns_played == 40, checked at the end of each turn
ending.decided_by: Every seat is ranked by team_score = pile_red + pile_green + pile_blue (every seat's total equals it), so all seats stand level. If team_score >= 13 (win_threshold), every seat reaches the bar and all seats win together. Otherwise no seat wins: the game ends with no winner. Pile progress counts even when the game ended because fuses reached 0.

rules.text: When the deck is built, then it has 30 cards: for each of R, G, B, three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s and one 5.
When setup runs, then deck_faces is a shuffle of the 30 faces and deck_ids is #1..#30 in order, with deck_ids[k] paired to deck_faces[k].
When any card moves, then its ID and face are removed from the same index of their paired lists and moved together, and no other record of the face exists.
When there are 2 players, then each hand has 5 cards and deck_count starts at 20.
When there are 3 players, then each hand has 4 cards and deck_count starts at 18.
When there are 4 players, then each hand has 4 cards and deck_count starts at 14.
When dealing with 3 players, then seat 1 holds #1-#4, seat 2 #5-#8, seat 3 #9-#12, and deck_ids holds #13-#30.
When any step ends, then deck_count equals the number of entries in deck_ids.
When a seat views the table, then it sees every seat's hand_ids and every other seat's hand_faces, but never its own hand_faces.
When the game starts, then the piles are 0, hint_tokens is 8, fuses is 3, team_score is 0, discard_pile and action_log are empty, turns_played is 0, final_turns_left is -1 and active_seat is 1.
When a turn begins, then only the active seat is asked; seats act in order 1..num_players and then seat 1 again.
When a turn begins, then the active seat's options are 'PLAY #id' and 'DISCARD #id' for each id in its hand, and every other seat's legal_options is empty.

When hint_tokens >= 1, then the active seat is also offered 'HINT s v' for each other seat s and each v in R,G,B,1-5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand; when hint_tokens is 0, no HINT is offered.
When a seat hints, then hint_tokens falls by 1, action_log gains a line naming giver, receiver, value and every matching ID in the receiver's hand, and no card moves or is drawn.
When a seat plays or discards #id, then the card at #id's index in its hand_ids is removed from both hand_ids and hand_faces.
When a played card's rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile, then that pile becomes the rank, team_score rises by 1, and action_log records the success with the face.
When a 5 is played successfully and hint_tokens is below 8, then hint_tokens rises by 1; at 8 it stays 8.
When a play fails, then fuses falls by exactly 1, '#id=face' is appended to discard_pile, the piles and team_score are unchanged, and action_log records the failure with the face.
When a seat discards, then '#id=face' is appended to discard_pile, hint_tokens rises by 1 to at most 8 (8 stays 8), and action_log records the discard with the face.
When a seat plays or discards and deck_ids is not empty, then the front entries of deck_ids and deck_faces move together to the end of that seat's hand_ids and hand_faces.
When a draw makes deck_count 0 and final_turns_left is -1, then final_turns_left is set to num_players + 1.

When a turn ends, then every seat's total is set to team_score, turns_played rises by 1, final_turns_left falls by 1 if it is above 0, and active_seat passes to the next seat (after the last seat, seat 1).
When fuses reaches 0 at the end of a turn, then the game ends.
When team_score reaches 15 at the end of a turn, then the game ends.
When final_turns_left reaches 0 at the end of a turn, then the game ends, so every player, including the one who drew the last card, has had one more turn after the deck emptied.
When turns_played reaches 40, then the game ends.
When the game is played, then there is no message phase and players communicate only through PLAY, DISCARD and HINT.
When the game ends with team_score >= 13, then every seat wins; with team_score below 13, no seat wins, even if the game ended on the third fuse.

offers.question: The active seat's turn action
offers.options: If hint_tokens >= 1: 'PLAY #id' for each id in its hand_ids, 'DISCARD #id' for each id in its hand_ids, and 'HINT s v' for each other seat s and each v in R,G,B,1,2,3,4,5 that matches at least one card in seat s's hand_faces. If hint_tokens == 0: only the PLAY and DISCARD options. Seats that are not active are not asked and are offered nothing.

choices.why: The designer chose 3, so it is kept. 2 is the smallest table where hints between players happen. 4 is the source maximum: the 30-card deck leaves only 14 cards to draw, and with more seats each player waits longer between turns and each hint matters less.

A thoughtful player reads the action_log to infer what a hint implies, spends scarce hint tokens on playable or critical cards, discards cards already played or with remaining duplicates, and avoids blind plays that burn fuses. A thoughtless player wastes hints or plays unknown cards.
R18 forbids any message phase. Limited communication is the core of the game, so no talk poll is added even though there are 3 or more players.

choices.what: Turn choice is an ask to the active seat only
choices.why: The rules give one seat one action per turn, so it is a sequential ask, not a poll.
R6 does not list them. Both can be worked out from public information (deck_count, turn order), and players need to know whose turn it is.
R6 does not list it as public. Its contents follow from the public hand_ids and discard_pile anyway, and it reveals no faces.

choices.what: Every seat is ranked by team_score, with min_to_win win_threshold: all seats share the win, or nobody wins
choices.why: The rules say the team wins or loses together, decided by team_score >= 13. Every seat's total equals team_score, so ranking by it puts all seats level.

choices.what: The failure log text is 'turn t: seat a plays #id = face, failure'
choices.why: R13 says only that the failure and face are recorded; the wording mirrors the success line in R12.

simplifications.what: A face's colour and rank are read from its two-character text (colour letter, rank digit)
simplifications.why: The engine compares numbers and text; this lets rank == pile + 1 and the hint matching be computed arithmetically, with no change to the rules.

simplifications.what: PLAY, DISCARD and HINT are three separate update steps, each guarded by a 'when' on the choice
simplifications.why: The step list is flat. Each branch is a single conditional update, which the engine supports.
